evidence.quote: During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026 .
evidence.one_line: Nvidia management forecast that hyperscaler spending would exceed $1 trillion in calendar 2027, after a projected $650 billion in calendar 2026.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia management, as reported by the author

evidence.quote: For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
evidence.one_line: The author said Wall Street analysts expected Nvidia growth of 82% for the rest of 2026 and 41% in 2027; the article does not specify the precise growth measure.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury
evidence.original_who: Wall Street analysts, as characterized by Keithen Drury

evidence.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
evidence.one_line: The author reported that the average analyst projected Nvidia FY2028 EPS of $12.76.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury
evidence.original_who: Average analyst, as reported by Keithen Drury

evidence.quote: In fact, I think it could easily rise over 50% to reach $300. But when might that occur?
evidence.one_line: Keithen Drury forecast that Nvidia shares could rise more than 50% to reach $300, without specifying a date in this statement.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury

evidence.quote: So I think the stock could easily reach $300 per share sometime in late 2027.
evidence.one_line: Keithen Drury forecast that Nvidia shares could reach $300 per share in late 2027.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury
